task_completion.description: Navigate to the National Archives website (archives.gov) to locate the Bill of Rights.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Browser address bar shows archives.gov and the page content displays National Archives branding and Bill of Rights information.

task_completion.description: Download the high-resolution image of the original Bill of Rights to the Downloads folder.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A download notification or a file manager view showing a large file (likely a PDF or high-res image over 1MB) named 'bill-of-rights' in the /home/ga/Downloads directory.

task_completion.description: Create a browser bookmark named 'Bill of Rights Text' for the transcript page.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The browser's bookmark manager or bookmark bar shows an entry titled 'Bill of Rights Text' pointing to the archives.gov transcript URL.

task_completion.description: Locate and copy the full text of Amendment I and Amendment IV from the transcript.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The transcript page is visible with the text for Amendment I ('Congress shall make no law...') and Amendment IV ('The right of the people to be secure...') highlighted or being copied.

task_completion.description: Create and save the document at /home/ga/Documents/amendment_worksheet.txt with the required labels and text.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or file manager shows a file at /home/ga/Documents/amendment_worksheet.txt containing the labels 'Amendment I' and 'Amendment IV' followed by their respective full transcript texts.

integrity.description: The agent used the web browser and GUI tools rather than just executing terminal commands to create the file or download the image.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse movements, clicks on browser elements, and interaction with the website's download buttons.

integrity.description: The agent actually visited the National Archives website to retrieve the text and image rather than using pre-cached information.
integrity.visual_evidence: The browser history or active tabs show the navigation path through archives.gov.

integrity.description: The agent copied the text from the website rather than typing it from memory to ensure accuracy.
integrity.visual_evidence: Visual evidence of text selection on the webpage and pasting into the text editor.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The high-resolution file is typically the PDF version (approx 1.3MB); smaller JPGs (~170KB) do not meet the high-resolution requirement. Amendment I must begin with 'Congress shall make no law respecting an establishment of religion'. Amendment IV must begin with 'The right of the people to be secure in their persons, houses, papers, and effects'. The file path must be exactly /home/ga/Documents/amendment_worksheet.txt.
